name: WDUi Framework SDK
changes_cs: Aktualizovany WDUi Framework SDK: SelectableTextBlock pri paintu a pointer hit-testu dlouhych textu pouziva viditelny line range misto skenovani celeho dokumentu. Self-test hlida, ze book-sized text repaint navstivi jen viewport lines.
changes_en: Updated WDUi Framework SDK: SelectableTextBlock now uses the visible line range for painting and pointer hit-testing long text instead of scanning the whole document. The self-test guards that book-sized text repaint visits only viewport lines.
